title: Floating cargo
text: Barrels bob in the swell, the wreck that spilled them nowhere in sight.

outcomes.text: Good rum and better coin. +15 gold.
One was a powder keg. It goes off against the hull. -5 hull.
You sail on. The crew grumbles.

title: Fishing village
text: A village of stilt houses. The headman offers timber for coin.

choices.text: Buy timber and patch the hull (10 gold)

outcomes.text: Your carpenter gets to work. -10 gold, +8 hull.
They point you to a sunken chest. +10 gold.
Pleasant evening, nothing more.

title: Survivors on a raft
text: A makeshift raft, a torn sail for a flag, and a dozen sunburnt faces waving at you.

outcomes.text: Grateful sailors, eager to sign on. +10 hands.
Fever came aboard with them. +10 hands, but -10 gold for medicine.

choices.text: Toss them a water cask and sail on

outcomes.text: They curse your name as you leave.

title: A Navy sloop signals
text: A Navy sloop runs up a signal: heave to and prepare to be inspected. Your flag is not the one they're looking for. Yet.

choices.text: Bluff it out with forged papers

outcomes.text: The lieutenant squints, stamps, and waves you on. Close.
The lieutenant isn't fooled. Run out the guns!
Gold changes hands. You were never here.
No sense waiting for them to make up their minds.

title: A castaway
text: A wild-bearded figure on a spit of sand, waving a shirt on a stick. He claims to have been a ship's surgeon, before the mutiny.

outcomes.text: He was telling the truth, mostly.
He was a ship's cook. He can still swing a cleaver.

choices.text: Leave him a cask of water

outcomes.text: He curses you all the way to the horizon.

title: A Company straggler
text: A Company merchantman, her foremast sprung, wallowing alone. Her crew hasn't seen you yet.

outcomes.text: You come down on her out of the sun.

choices.text: Shadow her and let her lead you to the convoy route

outcomes.text: She limps home and you learn the Company's lanes.
She spots you and signals. Every Company ship for leagues knows your sail.

title: A ship of the dead
text: A brig drifting with her sails in rags. No one at the helm. The smell reaches you before she does.

choices.text: Send a party aboard to loot her

outcomes.text: Spices and coin, and nothing caught. Lucky.
Fever comes back with the loot.

choices.text: Let your surgeon check her first

outcomes.text: The surgeon finds the fever's source and you strip her clean.
Better safe. The crew mutter about wasted plunder.

title: Rum smugglers
text: A low schooner, gunwales almost awash with casks. Her captain hails you cheerfully: rum for sale, no questions.

outcomes.text: Fine Barbados rum, mostly.
They hand it over sullenly. Word gets around.
They'd rather fight. So be it.
The crew watch the casks go by with longing.

title: Strange waters
text: The sea boils ahead, a great slow turning of water around a dark centre.

choices.text: Steer around it, the long way

outcomes.text: A day lost, but the ship is whole.

choices.text: Trust your helmsman to skirt the edge

outcomes.text: The helmsman threads the edge like a needle. The crew cheer.
You make it, just, with spars cracking.
The current takes you. You claw free with the hull groaning.

title: A slaver's tender
text: A tender pulling hard for a slaver brig at anchor, low in the water with chained captives.

outcomes.text: You'll not let this pass.

choices.text: Cut the tender off and free who you can

outcomes.text: You take the tender without a shot. The freed men join you.
The brig sees you and slips her cable. You free the tender's few.
The crew are quiet for a long while.

title: A message in a bottle
text: Bobbing alongside: a bottle, sealed with wax. Inside, a scrap of map and a few words: 'Company payroll, three days east.'

outcomes.text: A Company pay sloop, right where it said.
Nothing there but empty sea and a wasted day.

choices.text: Sell the tip at the next port

outcomes.text: A fence pays well for a rumour.

title: Red sky at morning
text: The sky to windward is the colour of a bruise, and the glass is dropping fast.

choices.text: Shorten sail and ride it out

outcomes.text: A hard night, but you come through.

choices.text: Run before it under full sail

outcomes.text: You fly ahead of the storm and gain a day on the Company.
The storm catches you with canvas up.

choices.text: Let the bosun rig storm sails

outcomes.text: The bosun knows his trade. Barely a rope frayed.

title: A Brotherhood courier
text: A fast pinnace flying the Brotherhood's black and red. Her captain wants your help: a Navy cutter has been taking Brotherhood prizes.

outcomes.text: For the Brotherhood!

choices.text: Give him powder and shot instead

outcomes.text: He thanks you with a share of his last prize.
He sails off, disappointed.

title: Too much grog
text: Somebody broached a cask in the night. Half the watch is singing and the other half is asleep at their posts.

outcomes.text: Order is restored. Nobody's singing now.

choices.text: Let it pass, and stop their grog for a week

outcomes.text: Grumbling, but no blood.
A night to remember, for those who can.

title: Pearl divers
text: A village of pearl divers. The headman offers a pouch of pearls for help against the Company factors who take half their catch.

outcomes.text: The factors' guard boat is no match for you. The pearls are yours.
The factors had friends. A Company ship arrives.

choices.text: Trade for pearls to sell on (10 gold)

outcomes.text: A tidy profit.
Not your fight.

title: Navy deserters
text: A longboat of half-starved sailors in Navy slops. They've run from a press-gang captain and want to sign with pirates.

outcomes.text: Good seamen, glad of the chance.

choices.text: Hand them back to the Navy for the reward

outcomes.text: A bounty paid on every head. Your crew look at you differently now.

choices.text: Point them to the nearest island

outcomes.text: They wave their thanks.

title: Mutiny!
text: The hands gather at the mainmast with cutlasses drawn. Their spokesman says it plainly: things change, or you go over the side.

choices.text: Pay them off with double shares (30 gold)

outcomes.text: Coin speaks louder than grievance. The cutlasses go back in their belts.
A cask is broached on deck. By nightfall they're singing, not plotting.

choices.text: Have the bosun talk them round

outcomes.text: The bosun knows every man by name. One by one, they back down.
They hear him out, then knock him flat. But the fire's gone out of them.
Three men swing from the yardarm. The rest go quietly back to work.
They fight for it. When it's over the deck is red and the survivors are cowed.

choices.text: Promise them a fat prize at the next sail

outcomes.text: They grumble, but they'll give you one more chance.
They've heard it before. You're put over the side in the jolly boat with a pistol and one shot. Your voyage ends here.

title: A black squall
text: A wall of cloud races across the water towards you, rain hissing on the waves ahead of it.

choices.text: Ride it out under bare poles

outcomes.text: It batters you for an hour, then is gone. Torn canvas and sprung planks.

choices.text: Have the bosun shorten sail in time

outcomes.text: Reefed and ready before it hits. You barely feel it.
You fly ahead of the squall and lose it, but far off your course.

title: Hurricane
text: The glass has fallen like a stone. The sky goes green, then black, and the sea rises in grey mountains.

outcomes.text: A night of horror. The ship survives. Not all the crew do.
A wave sweeps the deck clean.

choices.text: Run for shelter behind the nearest island

outcomes.text: You find a lee and wait out the storm at anchor, eating into your rum.

choices.text: Lash everything down and let the carpenter work

outcomes.text: The carpenter is everywhere at once, shoring up the hull as it groans. You come through.

title: Waterspouts
text: Three twisting columns of water dance across the sea between you and your heading.

outcomes.text: Your helmsman puts her through like a needle. The crew cheer themselves hoarse.

choices.text: Fire a broadside into the nearest one

outcomes.text: An old sailor's trick, and it works: the spout collapses in a great shower.
It doesn't work. The spout brushes your bow and tears away rigging.
Safe, and slow.

title: X marks the cay
text: A spit of sand and three palm trees, just as the old chart showed. Somewhere under them is a chest.

outcomes.text: Iron-bound and heavy with coin. The crew whoop like boys.
A trap: the pit collapses as you lift the chest. You save some of it.
Rivals were watching the cay. Their sloop rounds the point as you dig.
You'll always wonder.

title: A wreck in the shallows
text: The ribs of an old treasure galleon lie in clear water, two fathoms down.

choices.text: Send divers down for the gold

outcomes.text: They come up with fistfuls of silver pieces of eight.
Sharks. You pull back what's left of the divers, and little else.
The carpenter rigs a hoist. Her magazine is dry, and full.
Let the dead keep their gold.

title: An old pirate's hoard
text: A cave on a nameless island, the walls scratched with tallies and the floor heaped with the plunder of a long-dead captain.

choices.text: Take it all for the ship's chest

outcomes.text: A fortune in coin and plate. The hands mutter about their share.

choices.text: Share it out among the crew

outcomes.text: Every man gets a fistful. You'll not find a happier crew on the seas.

choices.text: Leave it. The place is cursed

outcomes.text: Nothing happens, but the crew sleep easier.
The crew think you a coward.

title: Lights in the fog
text: Lanterns drift in the fog ahead, keeping pace with you. No ship answers your hail.

outcomes.text: They lead you to a drifting, empty brig. Her strongbox is still aboard.
The lights go out. When the fog lifts you're on a reef.
Wreckers! A sloop comes out of the fog with her guns run out.
The crew are glad of it.

title: A Company packet
text: A fast little packet boat flying Company colours, carrying dispatches to the fleet.

choices.text: Take her and read the dispatches

outcomes.text: Patrol routes, convoy times and the names of the captains hunting you. Very useful.

choices.text: Sink her before she reports you

outcomes.text: She goes down with her letters. Somebody will miss her.
She'll report your position.

title: Marooned
text: A dozen ragged men wave from a sandbar. Their captain marooned them for talking of mutiny.

outcomes.text: Grateful and hard-working. For now.
Grateful, but they bring their grievances with them.

choices.text: Take only the one who claims he was a sailing master

outcomes.text: He knows his business.
Their curses follow you over the water.

title: A card sharp
text: There's been a run of luck at the gaming table on the gun deck, and it's all been one man's.

outcomes.text: Marked cards up both sleeves. The crew get their money back and he gets a ducking.
Nothing on him. He was just lucky, and now he's sulking.
Justice is rough but quick. He'll fetch a ransom with the others.
If he's that good with numbers... the crew think it's a fine joke.

title: Traders in canoes
text: Canoes put out from the shore loaded with fruit, fresh water and timber, and the paddlers wave you in.

choices.text: Trade rum for timber and fresh food (4 rum)

outcomes.text: Good timber for the carpenter and fresh fruit for the hands.

choices.text: Trade shot for gold dust (5 chain shot)

outcomes.text: They value iron more than gold.
They paddle back to shore.

title: Becalmed
text: Not a breath of wind for two days. The sails hang limp and the pitch bubbles in the deck seams.

outcomes.text: It comes at last, but the heat has worn on everyone.

choices.text: Put the boats out and tow her

outcomes.text: Back-breaking work, but you find the wind by nightfall.

choices.text: Splice the mainbrace to pass the time

outcomes.text: If you can't sail, you may as well sing.

title: Rats in the hold
text: The cook comes up white-faced: the rats have got into the stores.

outcomes.text: Brimstone in the hold. The rats are gone, and most of the rum with them.
The smoke gets out of hand. A small fire, quickly put out.

choices.text: Let the ship's cat earn her keep

outcomes.text: She does her best. You still lose some stores.
The hands make a game of it. 300 tails by the end of the dog watch.
